markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
One-class conformal set; second model and 5/5 neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 100%, Benign 0% | Normal dominates |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / percentile 1.0 | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 1, 7, 11) · context · Above-typical score; descriptive only [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Low score leans away from invasive · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 8) · ↓ invasive · High score associated with lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Nuclear pleomorphism** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Low score leans away from invasive · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions beats random by 0.54 logit (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so unproven; mitoses (0/20) is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated blur was applied; the reliability score ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69).
- Calibration error CI reaches 0.18 on 132 cases; 100% may be overstated.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 8, 4** — Least benign-leaning by heatmap; confirm no invasive foci.
2. **Regions 1, 7, 11** — Confirm the lymphocytic infiltrate; its spot check was only 8/20.
3. **Region 8** — Check stroma and nuclei; it tops four concept scores.
